'''Killik hive mounds'''<ref name="TUR" /> were towering, organic-looking monoliths that made up the hives of the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]].<ref name="ISWU" /> Their mounds were located on the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="AoR" /> such as [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]],<ref name="ISWU" /> [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]],<ref name="TUR" /> [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]],<ref name="AoR" /> and their [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Yoggoy]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="DN1" />
